description: Pile-in / consolidate always clamped the DROP to 3" — but the model followed the cursor out to arm's length first and only jumped back on release, so the live preview lied about where it would end up. Part A (setting ON, the new default): a Custodian Guard model is dragged 16" toward the enemy with the button still held, and its live position must already be held at the 3" cap, so the ghost is the truth. Part B (setting OFF): the same drag runs the full distance mid-flight, reproducing the old snap-back — and the release then delivers NOTHING — the far position fails the overlap / must-move-closer checks that run before the drop's own distance clamp, so the model reverts to where it started and the whole pile-in is lost. That is exactly the cost the clamp removes. Distances are measured against the model's ORIGINAL position, which is what _end_model_drag_pile_in judges the drop with.

steps.script:
# Part A: clamp ON (the default). Record the model's original position so the
# assertions measure exactly what the drop check measures.
SettingsService.set_drag_clamp_to_max_range(true)
var fc = tree.root.get_node("Main").fight_controller
var key = fc.original_model_positions.keys().filter(func(k): return str(k).ends_with(":m1") and str(k).begins_with("U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_B"))
return SettingsService.drag_clamp_to_max_range

# Frame the pile-in so the model, its 3" stop and the far cursor are all legible
# in the screenshots. screen = (world - view_offset) * view_zoom.
var m = tree.root.get_node("Main")
m.view_zoom = 1.3
m.view_offset = Vector2(200.0 - 700.0 / 1.3, 100.0 - 300.0 / 1.3)
m.update_view_transform()
return true

# Part B: reset the model and repeat with the setting OFF.
var fc = tree.root.get_node("Main").fight_controller
for key in fc.original_model_positions.keys():
	fc.current_model_positions[key] = fc.original_model_positions[key]
fc._update_pile_in_visuals()
SettingsService.set_drag_clamp_to_max_range(false)
return not SettingsService.drag_clamp_to_max_range

# With the clamp OFF the over-range drop delivers NOTHING: the far position
# fails the overlap / must-move-closer checks that run BEFORE the drop
# distance clamp, so the model is reverted to where it started and the
# player loses the whole pile-in. That is the cost the clamp removes — with
# it on (above) the same gesture banks the full 3".
var m = tree.root.get_node("Main")
var fc = m.fight_controller
var key = str(m.get_meta("pile_in_key", ""))
if key == "" or not fc.original_model_positions.has(key):
	return false
var orig = fc.original_model_positions[key]
var final_in = Measurement.px_to_inches(orig.distance_to(fc.current_model_positions[key]))
m.set_meta("pile_in_off_drop_probe", "final=%.3f\"" % final_in)
return final_in <= 0.05
